title: OreExcavator
body:
![Breaking some ores](https://i.imgur.com/OGV9t0P.gif)

Ore Excavator transforms the mining experience by allowing players to mine entire ore veins instantly while keeping Minecraft balanced and enjoyable.

Designed for survival servers, SMPs, and communities that value quality-of-life improvements without ruining progression.

✨ Features
⛏️ Vein Mining
Break one ore block and automatically mine all connected ores of the same type.

⚙️ Fully Configurable
Customize everything:

Supported ores
Maximum vein size
Tool durability usage
Experience drops
Permissions
Messages & sounds
Fortune & Silk Touch Support
Works perfectly with enchanted tools and respects vanilla mechanics.

Balanced Gameplay
Tool durability is consumed correctly for every mined block, preventing overpowered gameplay.

Optimized Performance
Built with performance in mind:

Smart block scanning
Vein size limits
Minimal server impact
Permissions Support
Perfect for server administration and rank systems.

Compatibility
Bukkit,
Spigot,
Paper,
Purpur
Supports:
Minecraft 1.20+,
Java 17+

Why Choose Ore Excavator?
Ore Excavator improves one of Minecraft’s most repetitive tasks without making the game feel unfair.

It keeps the survival experience intact while making mining faster, smoother, and far more enjoyable.

Perfect for:

Survival Servers,
SMPs,
Lifesteal Servers,
Economy Servers,
Community Servers
